findings_and_revisits.classification: Existing conditional historical observer-scoped cache finding, independently source-traced at 95e; no new unique count.
findings_and_revisits.reasoning: Join validates gateway, catalog, living character and presence, respects authored player role max, inserts the participant and refreshes options using the joining character. The refresh deletes the session options then computes character-specific known topics, facts and bound effects, writes session:topic keys, while the gateway view projects every row to each dialogue_viewer_ids member. If an admitted conversation permits multiple player participants with different knowledge or eligibility, the last refresher can determine the shared options exposed to others.
findings_and_revisits.conditions_and_limits: The actual installed >1-player catalog, admitted live states and unauthorized effects are not established. Historical F030 notes actual effects/topic choices revalidate actor authority, so this is presentation/issued-binding availability, not an established unauthorized effect. External invalidation beyond the inspected actions remains open. No product session or validation performed.

findings_and_revisits.classification: Existing 059 conditional extreme exhaustion question, current source support; no new unique count.
findings_and_revisits.reasoning: The private puzzle state retains u32 revision; retry receipt identity includes challenge, party and expected revision, and a new answer checks current revision. Resulting revision uses saturating_add(1). Once revision reaches MAX, an accepted wrong attempt at MAX leaves MAX and creates its receipt, so another distinct answer at MAX encounters the same receipt instead of a fresh revision, subject to the retry validation contract recorded in 059.
findings_and_revisits.conditions_and_limits: This requires exhaustion near 2^32 accepted attempts under actual guards or another supported path to MAX, plus the exact retry validator; no ordinary incident or reachable live challenge established. We did not inspect retry validator body in this task; conflict semantics derive from the explicitly attributed historical PL13-297 receipt, not newly claimed read. No execution or seeded state.
findings_and_revisits.historical_relationship: 059 q3294 PL13-297-PUZZLE-REVISION-EXHAUSTION-POLICY, delegated Lens13 READ-PL13-297 pr-working 6533 body 1246–1458; current challenges source matches that exact old PR blob. The small-counter and other revision policies are not assumed aliases.
findings_and_revisits.future_repair_direction: Decide exhaustion semantics explicitly; preserve exact-retry identity and distinguish any new answer at the limit. No design or repair chosen here.
